review:
A game built entirely around wheels. When a Fortuna symbol lands, it spins a Regular, Super or Epic wheel, whose arrow stops on one of 12 slices – adding multipliers, multiplying ones or jackpot prizes. Everything goes into the Cash Prize Bar, paid as multiples of your bet.

Three FS give 10 spins with more wheels; four give 10 where every wheel is Super or Epic; five unlock the strongest bonus. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game. For wheel lovers.
